title: Special Executive Masters Programme in Public Health Management
description: Public Health Management is the strategic bridge between science and policy, empowering leaders to optimize health outcomes and promote equitable access to healthcare for all.
longDescription: The SEMP Public Health Management is a multidisciplinary program designed to equip students with the knowledge, skills, and practical experience needed to manage and improve the health of communities and populations. Through instruction, hands-on experience, and real-world case studies, students will learn about various topics, including epidemiology, healthcare policy and administration, biostatistics, health informatics, environmental health, and health communication. Graduates of the program will be prepared to take on leadership roles in various settings, including government agencies, non-profit organizations, healthcare systems, and international health organizations, working to address some of the most pressing public health challenges of our time. We don’t just give you the theory; we ensure you learn how to apply it in your working life immediately, with case studies, webinars, and business simulations, and 100% project-based. Special Executive Masters Program in Public Health Management allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. Public Health Management is the strategic bridge between science and policy, empowering leaders to optimize health outcomes and promote equitable access to healthcare for all.
courseDetails: Assessment: Assignments The objective of the SEMP in Public Health Management qualification is to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary for effective public health program planning, implementation, and evaluation, to enable students to analyze the social, economic, and environmental determinants of health and to develop interventions that address health inequities and to prepare students for leadership roles in public health, including management of public health organizations, policymaking, and community engagement. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme consists of 6 modules with a total of 120 credits.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: The content of this course has been independently certified as conforming to universally accepted Continuous Professional Development (CPD) guidelines. All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

modules.title: RESEARCH METHODS
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ ability to prepare for various types of academically based management research through the development and design of a research proposal. Learners will develop a critical understanding of the philosophical, practical and ethical concepts of research within the context of the business environment.
